description:
Verified root cause of 25 of the 37 comments on core issue #2979 (2026-10-15T12:02Z to 2026-10-16T14:34Z, every develop push): the parent lookup (scripts/site_inputs_parent.py after #2955 'Resolve site-inputs bundle parents by commit SHA', 210f965bd, and #2988 'parent bundles on the production-deployed core SHA', b92c91f8e) filtered workflow runs by head_sha equal to the bundle's core SHA. For workflow_run-triggered bundles the run's head_sha is not the bundled core SHA (run 38673016998 has head_sha 5bce4dbe... while its artifact is site-inputs-a9c80901...), so the lookup returned 'missing' for an artifact that existed ('site-inputs bundle for deployed parent a9c80901... is missing', run 38916758608). Fixed by #2987 (7ae0fad48, 2026-10-16T14:31Z): find parent bundles by artifact name and verify the producing run.
Work: verify tests/unit/scripts/test_site_inputs_parent.py pins the exact shape (run head_sha differs from artifact core SHA; trusted trunk run; expired artifact; untrusted producing run) for both parent_bundle_state and the deployed-parent path; add any missing case. Record the script-version hazard (the bundle build checks out the triggering commit, so a fixed script does not repair builds for older triggers) in context; no change unless trivial.
If the tests already pin every case, finish with the evidence and no PR.
